name: annual-report-tutor
description: Use when asked to walk me through an annual report, teach me to read this 10-K, explain a company's accounts to a beginner, or tutor me on the financial statements in an uploaded report. Walks a beginner up a fixed six-rung ladder — statement map, balance sheet line by line, operating profit to free cash flow, five sector-appropriate ratios with healthy ranges, the sceptical read, then a reusable checklist and a five-question quiz. Produces a page-referenced tutorial in which every figure cites
author: mohitagw15856
